simple.meaning: צָמַד (tsâmad) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to link , i.e. gird ; figuratively, to serve , (mentally) contrive.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across Numbers, 2 Samuel, Psalms, beginning at Numbers 25:3. Its contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָמַד (H6775).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel.

timeline.evidenceText: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel.
Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”

When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.
They joined themselves also to Baal Peor,

definitions.full: H6775. tsamad [ צָמַד ] verb bind, join (Arabic bind, wind , specifically of girl with two lovers We GGN 1893, 470 ; fasten (cattle) to yoke Dozy, yoke , Id. ; Assyrian ƒmâdu , bind , harness , so Ethiopic and III. be attached, attach oneself , specifically be (religiously) devoted ; Aramaic צְמַד , , bind ); — Niph`al Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיִּצָּ֫מֶד Num 25:3 ; 3 masculine plural וַיִּצָּֽדְֶוּ Psa 106:28 ; Participle plural נִעצמָדִים Num 25:5 ; join, attach, oneself to ( ל ) Baal Peor, i.e. adopt his worship 25:3 , 5 (JE), whence Psa 106:28 . Pu`al Participle feminine צְצֻמֶּ֫דֶת 2Sam 20:8 a sword bound upon ( עַל ) his loins. Hiph`il Imperfect 3feminine singular מִרְמָה תַּצְמִיד Psa 50:19 thy tongue combineth (fitteth together, frameth) deceit (> denominative from צֶמֶד Gerber 170 ).
